title: One kernel-backed repository lease
summary: All local Git ref/object/worktree mutation is coordinated by one AlchemyRepositoryLease. The ooRexx object owns policy/lifecycle while a tiny shell holder owns flock(2); owner death releases the kernel lock without stale-directory heuristics.
invariants: Do not create per-component lock conventions for sender, seeder, inbox, snapshots or publication.
The lease is bound to the ordinary repository handle's .git lock path, not to a disposable worktree.
The holder reports LOCKED only after flock succeeds.
If the owning Rexx process disappears, becomes a zombie, or is replaced, the helper exits and the kernel releases the lock.
There is no stale lock-directory recovery protocol.

provenance.claim: Lease authority, flock carrier and no-stale-lock doctrine.
Acquisition, owner liveness and release lifecycle.
